exercises.title: Request log analyzer
exercises.description: Build a command-line tool that parses web request logs and reports status counts and the slowest request.

exercises.title: Inventory ledger
exercises.description: Process deliveries and sales in order, rejecting invalid stock changes and reporting the final inventory.

exercises.title: LRU cache
exercises.description: Build a reusable cache that updates recency on access and evicts the least recently used entry at capacity.

exercises.title: Job runner
exercises.description: Queue different kinds of jobs, run them in order, and record successes and failures without stopping the queue.

exercises.title: Message pipeline
exercises.description: Build a reusable pipeline of transformations and checks whose steps can keep state across messages.

exercises.title: Event feed
exercises.description: Merge two ordered event streams lazily while preserving input order and handling timestamp ties.

exercises.title: Equipment desk
exercises.description: Manage equipment loans, waitlists, returns, cancellations, and new stock while keeping shared state consistent.
